title: León Visits Puebla and Draws in Match Marked by Absences and Wonder Goals
seoTitle: León Draws 1-1 at Puebla in Apertura 2026 Match
subtitle: The clash between the two Apertura 2026 sides ends 1-1, highlighted by the Colombian striker's absence and Eduardo Armenta's goal
excerpt: León and Puebla tied 1-1 in Apertura 2026. Daniel Arcila sat on the bench after national duty, while Eduardo Armenta scored for the Mexican side, keeping.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the afternoon of October 9, Club León traveled to Estadio Cuauhtémoc to face Puebla, a side sitting in ninth place with 14 points. The clash, significant for the tournament's provisional leadership, ended in a 1-1 draw.

Daniel Arcila's Absence in León's Attack

The main name in León's attack, Daniel Arcila, was not named in the starting lineup. The forward, who recently returned from Colombia's senior national team, was rested to avoid overload following the FIFA window. Despite not starting the match, Arcila was available on the bench, ready to come on if manager Javier Gandolfi chose to use him.

Eduardo Armenta's Goal Secures a Point for Puebla

Puebla's only goal was scored by Eduardo Armenta. The forward received an assist from Juan Vargas following a corner kick and finished right-footed from outside the box, taking the score to 1-0. The goal was captured by the TUDN broadcast.

León Fights Back and Equalizes Through Ismael Díaz

León found the equalizer shortly after through Ismael Díaz, who had already opened the scoring for the team on another occasion. Díaz's goal leveled the scoreline, ending the match at 1-1.

Impact on the Table and Upcoming Challenges

With this result, León stayed on 17 points, remaining in fifth place, while Puebla earned a point, still sitting in ninth. Manager Gandolfi emphasized the importance of taking advantage of the FIFA international break to recover the called-up players and prepare for upcoming fixtures against sides such as Toluca, América, and Tigres.

Performance Summary and Outlook

The match highlighted León's away vulnerability, a recurring theme this season, and Puebla's ability to capitalize on opportunities, such as Armenta's goal. Both clubs now head into the next round aiming to consolidate their positions in the standings, counting on the return of their internationals and maintaining the fitness of their key players.

With information from Bolavip México, TUDN, fieramania.mx.
